inputs.why: the manifest decides what is packed and how it is rewritten
the bundle build decides the payload files
the generated presets are part of the payload
an ignore file changes which files are packed
the lockfile pins the build toolchain that produces the payload
the workspace layout decides how pnpm resolves and packs
the comparator defines what equivalent means
the protocol is the pair of commands being compared
